prova:
intro t d ht
by_cases hd : d = 0
· have hd0 : d = 0 := hd
  have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := ht
  have h0 : h t d = 0 := by
    have h1 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
        (∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ d) → 0 ≤ G.edgeSet.ncard → HasFarEdges G t := by
      intro n G _ _
      cases t with
      | zero =>
        exfalso
        exact Nat.not_lt_zero (lt_of_lt_eq ht1 hd0)
      | succ t' =>
        have h2 : ¬ ∃ (u v : Fin n), G.Adj u v := by
          intro h3
          rcases h3 with ⟨u, v, huv⟩
          have h4 : u ∈ G.neighborSet v := by
            simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_neighborSet] using iff.mpr (And.intro huv (by simp))
          have h5 : (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≥ 1 := by
            calc
              (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≥ Finset.card (Finset.filter (fun x => x ∈ G.neighborSet v) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) := by
                simp [Finset.card_filter]
              _ = 1 := by
                have h6 : ∃ x : Fin n, x ∈ G.neighborSet v := ⟨u, h4⟩
                have h7 : (Finset.filter (fun x => x ∈ G.neighborSet v) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).Nonempty := by
                  exact Finset.nonempty_filter.mpr ⟨u, by simp [h4]⟩
                have h8 : (Finset.filter (fun x => x ∈ G.neighborSet v) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))).card ≥ 1 := by
                  exact Finset.card_nonempty.1 h7
                linarith
              _ = 1 := by rfl
          have h9 : (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ d := by
            exact (by assumption) v
          have h10 : d = 0 := hd0
          have h11 : (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ 0 := by
            simpa [h10] using h9
          have h12 : (G.neighborSet v).ncard = 0 := by
            exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h11
          exact (Nat.ne_of_gt h5 h12)
        exact by
          intro h13
          rcases h13 with ⟨u, v, w, x, huv, hw x_, h14⟩
          exact h2 ⟨u, v, huv⟩
    exact Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (Nat.sInf_le h1)
  have h13 : 2 * h t d = 0 := by
    simp [h0]
  have h14 : 3 * d ^ t + 2 = 2 := by
    have h15 : d ^ t = 0 := by
      have h16 : t ≥ 1 := ht
      have h17 : d = 0 := hd0
      exact Nat.pow_eq_zero_iff.2 (Option.some (by simp [h17]))
    simp [h15]
  simp [h13, h14]
· have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := hd
  have h_comb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
      (∀ v, (G.neighborSet v).ncard ≤ d) → ((3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2) ≤ G.edgeSet.ncard → HasFarEdges G t := by
    intro n G hdeg hedges
    have h1 : ∃ (u v : Fin n), G.Adj u v := by
      have h2 : G.edgeSet.ncard ≥ 1 := by
        have h3 : (3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2 ≥ 1 := by
          have h4 : d ≥ 1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0
          have h5 : d ^ t ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow t d h4
          have h6 : 3 * d ^ t + 2 ≥ 5 := by
            calc
              3 * d ^ t + 2 ≥ 3 * 1 + 2 := by
                gcongr
                <;> omega
              _ = 5 := by rfl
          omega
        omega
      have h7 : G.edgeSet.ncard = (Finset.univ : Finset (G.Adj ×ˣ G.Adj)).card := by rfl
      have h8 : (Finset.univ : Finset (G.Adj ×ˣ G.Adj)).card ≥ 1 := by
        omega
      have h9 : ∃ (e : G.Adj ×ˣ G.Adj), True := by
        exact Finset.univ_nonempty.1
      exact by
        obtain ⟨e, _⟩ := h9
        exact ⟨e.1, e.2, e.right⟩
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := h1
    have h2 : ∃ (w x : Fin n), G.Adj w x := by
      have h3 : G.edgeSet.ncard ≥ 1 := by
        have h4 : (3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2 ≥ 1 := by
          have h5 : d ≥ 1 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hd0
          have h6 : d ^ t ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow t d h5
          have h7 : 3 * d ^ t + 2 ≥ 5 := by
            calc
              3 * d ^ t + 2 ≥ 3 * 1 + 2 := by
                gcongr
                <;> omega
              _ = 5 := by rfl
          omega
        omega
      have h8 : ∃ (e : G.Adj ×ˣ G.Adj), True := by
        exact Finset.univ_nonempty.1
      obtain ⟨e, _⟩ := h8
      exact ⟨e.1, e.2, e.right⟩
    obtain ⟨w, x, hwx⟩ := h2
    have h3 : ∀ a ∈ ({u, v} : Set (Fin n)), ∀ b ∈ ({w, x} : Set (Fin n)), (t : ℕ∞) ≤ G.edist a b := by
      intro a ha b hb
      have h4 : True := by simp
      exact by
        have h5 : G.edist a b = ⊤ := by
          have h6 : ¬ G.Connected a b := by
            intro h7
            have h8 : G.path a b := by
              obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h7
              exact ⟨p, by simp [hp]⟩
            have h9 : G.Connected a b := by
              rcases h8 with ⟨p, hp⟩
              exact ⟨p, by simp [hp]⟩
            contradiction
          exact edist_eq_top_of_not_connected h6
        simp [h5]
    exact ⟨u, v, w, x, huv, hwx, h3⟩
  have h_bound : h t d ≤ (3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2 := by
    unfold h
    exact Nat.sInf_le h_comb
  have h15 : 2 * h t d ≤ 3 * d ^ t + 2 := by
    calc
      2 * h t d ≤ 2 * ((3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ ≤ 3 * d ^ t + 2 := by
        have h16 : 2 * ((3 * d ^ t + 2) / 2) ≤ 3 * d ^ t + 2 := by
          apply Nat.mul_div_le'
          <;> omega
        exact h16
  exact h15
